name: Daan Viljoen Game Park
subtitle: A small game park in the Khomas Hochland west of the city.

facts.label: Mammals
facts.value: Springbok, kudu, eland, gemsbok, wildebeest, Hartmann's mountain zebra, leopard, klipspringer

parts.text: A small game park in the Khomas Hochland west of the city. It is home to springbok, kudu and mountain zebra.
